text:
incident-bot: ALERT: p99 latency SLO breach for AventisHealth (dedicated pool p-8432) in eu-west-3. Metric: p99 4.8s (> SLO 3.0s). Triggered at 2026-03-01T14:12:00Z
SRE_Jin: ack — I'm on call. Pulling metrics and logs now. @Alex_Patel can you join for pool scaling?
Alex_Patel: on it, looking at dashboards... p95 rose to 2.1s, p99 to 4.8s, request rate steady. Not seeing CPU throttles on hosts but queue depth increased on host-23.
Maria_Gonzalez: paging from support: AventisHealth reporting slow responses from their VPC endpoint. They have a dedicated pool with tenant isolation. SE_Robert please loop in.
SE_Robert: pinged Aventis SE. They're seeing latency on write-heavy tenants. Sending initial customer note: 'We're investigating — will update in 10m.'
EngOncall_Tara: running quick KV cache stats:
```
ri-metrics query --pool p-8432 --metric kv_cache_miss_rate --range 10m
result:  miss_rate=0.47
```
SRE_Jin: KV cache miss nearly 50% — that increases compute. Also seeing longer model token generation times on larger sequences. Logs from host-23:
```
[14:10:12] queue_depth=96 model_task_ms=3200 gpu_util=72% kernel_wait=400ms
[14:10:20] queue_depth=120 model_task_ms=4100 gpu_util=85% kernel_wait=600ms
```
Alex_Patel: looks like sustained queuing. Two mitigation options: (A) scale pool by adding 2 nodes (fast but may take ~3-4m to warm), (B) enable tenant-level rate limiting for top noisy tenant (quick, no infra change). Recommend both in parallel.
Maria_Gonzalez: customer impact: Aventis uses the pool for batch and interactive. Interactive slow for specific tenant 'Aventis-Prod-Tenant-A' — if we throttle that tenant they'll still be able to run batches later.
SRE_Jin: executing scale now and preparing tenant throttle. Running command:
```
rictl pool scale --region eu-west-3 --pool-id p-8432 --add 2
```
incident-bot: ACTION: scale request submitted (job j-9987). ETA pool nodes ready: ~210s. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Alex_Patel: configuring tenant throttle rule:
```
rictl tenant update-rate --tenant-id tenant-A --pool p-8432 --rps 5 --burst 10
```
EngOncall_Tara: applied throttle, confirming route table unaffected. Will monitor latency for tenant-A.
SRE_Jin: also enabling cross-region fallback to eu-west-1 for canary routing for new interactive calls:
```
rictl routing set-fallback --pool p-8432 --fallback-region eu-west-1 --percent 10
```
SE_Robert: looped in Account Exec Liam. Sending brief to customer: 'We've applied targeted throttling to one high-traffic tenant and are adding capacity; we expect latency to improve in 5–8 minutes. We'll confirm when p99 < 3s.'
AcctExec_Liam: received. I'll update the customer Slack channel and offer to coordinate their internal throttling. Keep me posted.
Maria_Gonzalez: quick metrics update (14:16Z): p95 1.9s, p99 3.6s, queue depth dropped to 48. Good sign.
incident-bot: job j-9987: nodes joined pool (2 nodes). Rebalancing KV cache. :white_check_mark:
Alex_Patel: nodes up — rebalancing shows KV cache warmup in progress, expect another few minutes. Observed burst of cache misses as new nodes pull state.
EngOncall_Tara: cache miss rate now 0.28, queue_depth 18, p99 2.8s.
SRE_Jin: p99 below SLO 3.0s — marking as mitigated. Will keep monitoring until stable for 30m. Creating incident channel and handoff notes.
SE_Robert: customer updated: 'Performance improved after our intervention. Please hold on full rollback until you confirm stability.'
AcctExec_Liam: customer asks for a follow-up postmortem and asks whether we can set an emergency quota for noisy tenants. Scheduling cust call 16:00Z.
Maria_Gonzalez: next steps: (1) collect kernel wait traces for hosts 21-24, (2) run workload analysis to identify noisy tenant patterns, (3) propose permanent autoscale rule to trigger at queue_depth>80, (4) recommend pre-warming policy for dedicated pools on business hours.
SRE_Jin: noted. I'll own kernel traces and postmortem draft. @Alex_Patel please propose autoscale config.
Alex_Patel: will put a PR with suggested autoscale policy and an example:
```
autoscale:
  trigger:
    metric: queue_depth
    threshold: 80
    cooldown: 300s
  scale: add: 2
```
ops-bot: Escalation summary posted to #incidents-log and created ticket INC-4532 for postmortem.
SRE_Jin: Handoff to oncall-Tara at 14:31Z for the monitoring window. Tara, keep watch for regression; if p99 >3.2s re-open war room and page senior SRE.
EngOncall_Tara: ack takeover. I'll keep 1:1 alerts on and contact SE_Robert if customer sees new symptoms. :mag:
incident-bot: THREAD CLOSED (mitigated) 14:35Z — monitoring window active. Please add notes to INC-4532.
